run_chat_cli: run the transformers chat CLI to interact with a language model via typer command-line interface
create_chat_session: create a chat session with a model using the Chat class and AsyncInferenceClient streaming
save_chat_history: save a chat conversation history and settings to a JSON file with timestamped filenames
parse_generate_flags: parse generate flags from CLI arguments into a dictionary of generation config kwargs
stream_model_output: stream model chat completion tokens to the console with rich markdown rendering and speed stats
